title: Comprehensive 5-Stage Scientific Ablation & Trade-off Matrix
description: Unified component-by-component evaluation showing continuous errors, complete 2x2 contingency counts, categorical metrics, paired bootstrap differences, and block sensitivity.

components.name: Raw ECMWF IFS (0.25°)
components.description: Uncalibrated operational numerical weather prediction model output.
components.operational_tradeoff: Substantial dry bias over Western Ghats; misses 81.7% of heavy rain events.

components.name: Spatial Smoothed NWP (3x3 Boxcar)
components.description: Uniform 3x3 boxcar spatial filtering as negative control.
components.operational_tradeoff: Slightly reduces RMSE via blurring, but degrades all spatial skill and heavy detection (POD drops to 0.164).

components.name: Global Empirical Quantile Mapping (EQM)
components.description: Single monotonic transfer function fitted across all dates and locations without synoptic conditioning.
components.operational_tradeoff: Corrects frequency bias (0.980 vs 0.586); generates spurious heavy false alarms on Break monsoon days.

components.name: Regime-Aware RQDM (Stage 1)
components.description: Conditioned quantile transfer functions per synoptic regime (Active, Break, Normal).
components.operational_tradeoff: Achieves exact aggregate frequency calibration (bias=1.000) and highest POD (0.303, +66% vs Raw), but high FAR persists (~70%).

components.name: RQDM + LightGBM Corrector (Stage 2)
components.description: Gradient-boosted decision tree corrector using terrain elevation, Arabian Sea distance, and 850 hPa wind moisture flux.
components.operational_tradeoff: Substantially cuts continuous RMSE (15.22 mm vs 18.69 mm) and slashes False Alarms (85 vs 571, FAR drops to 0.429); but severely underpredicts frequency (bias=0.242) and increases misses (706 vs 571).

Stage1_minus_GlobalEQM.scientific_finding: Stage 1 shows small incremental categorical gain over Global EQM (+0.003 ETS, +0.008 POD), with 95% CI spanning zero on single-season sample.

Stage2_minus_Stage1.scientific_finding: Stage 2 yields statistically significant continuous improvement (RMSE -3.47 mm, FAR -0.268), at the explicit cost of lower categorical POD (-0.165) and higher misses (+135 misses).

block_bootstrap_sensitivity.description: Single-day cluster resampling (all 324 stations on sampled date kept together)
3-day consecutive blocks without bridging missing-date gaps
